name: layer-spread-bot
description: Example bot on the uselayer SDK: best venue and cross-venue arbitrage, run on your machine with your own keys.

scripts.setup: npm ci && cd engine && uv sync
scripts.dev:engine: cd engine && uv run uvicorn spread_engine.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${ENGINE_PORT:-8765} --no-access-log
scripts.test: vitest run && cd engine && uv run pytest -q
scripts.smoke: cd engine && uv run python scripts/smoke.py
scripts.record: cd engine && uv run python scripts/record.py
